articles.headline: Norwegian club win CAS case over 'UEFA mafia' banners and chants
articles.description: Norwegian club SK Brann claimed victory for free speech on Sunday with the CAS ruling that they did not have to pay a fine imposed by UEFA.

 [1296x729]

articles.headline: Man of the match usually gets champagne. This guy got eggs.
articles.description: Goalkeeper Jan de Boer was named man of the match in Bryne's Norwegian league season opener against Bodo/Glimt. His reward? Four trays of eggs.

images.name: Eggs [1296x729]
images.credit: Sebastian Kahnert/picture alliance via Getty Images

images.name: Amazing kickoff goal from halfway in Irish women's league
images.caption: Shamrock Rovers' Ruesha Littlejohn catches the opposition goalkeeper off guard to score directly from kick-off in the League of Ireland.

articles.headline: Norway votes to keep VAR despite opposition from clubs
articles.description: Norwegian soccer decided to keep using video reviews to assist referees in its top league after a vote at a congress of its national soccer federation on Saturday.

images.name: Why the Norwegian FA ignored clubs' calls to scrap VAR
images.caption: Gab Marcotti and Julien Laurens discuss the outcome of the Norwegian FA's vote on whether to keep using VAR.

articles.headline: Norway top-flight clubs vote to scrap VAR amid fan outrage
articles.description: Norway is set to become the first country to abandon VAR after 19 of its 32 clubs voted Wednesday to scrap video refereeing in the country's top division.

images.name: The surprising ways Norwegian fans have been protesting against VAR
images.caption: Mark Ogden speaks about how Norwegian football fans have been using tennis balls and fish cakes to protest against VAR.

articles.headline: Fans vs. VAR: Norway's fight for football's future
articles.description: Protests involving fishcakes and tennis balls turned Norway's anti-VAR movement into a global news story, and the attention has led to a vote. Could they vote VAR out of the league?

images.name: The surprising ways Norwegian fans have been protesting against VAR
images.caption: Mark Ogden speaks about how Norwegian football fans have been using tennis balls and fish cakes to protest against VAR.

articles.headline: Fishcake & tennis ball protest causes Norwegian match abandonment
articles.description: Fans upset with VAR in the Norwegian top flight cause a match to be abandoned by throwing fishcakes, tennis balls and smoke bombs onto the field.

images.name: Fishcake & tennis ball protest causes Norwegian match abandonment
images.caption: Fans upset with VAR in the Norwegian top flight cause a match to be abandoned by throwing fishcakes, tennis balls and smoke bombs onto the field.
